successCriteria.description: A project-wide search for `LeaveTypeService` and `PgLeaveTypeRepository` under `src/modules/balance/` returns zero matches — the balance module (routes, service, repository, index) has no direct import of, or reference to, the leave-type module.

`src/modules/balance/balance.routes.ts` imports only Fastify types, shared errors/types, and the balance service (`IBalanceService`/`createBalanceService`); it contains no inline construction of a policy service and no leave-type import.

The balance module's dependency chain is `balance → policy` only: `createBalanceService()` obtains its `IPolicyService` via the policy module's public entry point (`createPolicyService` from `src/modules/policy`), and no balance file imports from `src/modules/leave-type`.
`npm run build` (tsc --noEmit) and the existing Jest suite pass with no new failures, confirming the dependency removal is behaviour-preserving.

constraints: The leave-type dependency must remain encapsulated inside the policy module's public factory `createPolicyService()` in `src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` — it is the only non-test, non-leave-type-module location allowed to construct `LeaveTypeService`/`PgLeaveTypeRepository`.

Cross-module imports must go through the module's public entry point (`index.ts`) only — balance may import `createPolicyService`/`IPolicyService` from `src/modules/policy`, never from `src/modules/leave-type`.
No circular dependency may be introduced: policy must not import from balance; the dependency direction stays balance → policy → leave-type.
The change is a pure dependency-graph refactor: no observable behaviour of `GET /balances/me` or any balance service operation may change (same inputs, outputs, and error semantics).
outOfScope: Refactoring the leave-type dependency out of the policy module itself — `createPolicyService()` continues to construct `LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository())`.
Any change to balance service behaviour, routes, or the `GET /balances/me` response shape — this phase is a dependency-graph cleanup only.
Adding new tests or new endpoints — the phase only verifies the existing dependency chain is already balance → policy.

entityInvariants.invariant: Obtains its policy collaborator only as an `IPolicyService` (via the policy module's public factory), never by constructing or importing leave-type classes directly; its constructor dependency on `IPolicyService` is unchanged.
Remains the sole owner of the leave-type dependency: it injects `ILeaveTypeService` and `createPolicyService()` is the only place that wires `LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository())`.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must remain the policy module's public factory returning a fully-wired `IPolicyService`; consumers (including balance) obtain policy services through it rather than constructing leave-type collaborators themselves.
Must continue to return a fully-wired `IBalanceService` whose policy collaborator is resolved via `createPolicyService()` (balance → policy only), with no leave-type import in the balance module.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The policy service factory signature and export must match the existing `createPolicyService(): IPolicyService` in `src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` and its re-export in `src/modules/policy/index.ts` — balance must reuse this exact factory, not a new or divergent one.

The balance service factory must keep the same `createBalanceService(): IBalanceService` signature and wiring (repository, employee service, policy service, unit of work) as currently declared in `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts`, changing only the source of the policy collaborator if any change is needed.

`balance.routes.ts` must keep its `resolveActor`/`sendError` helpers and `GET /balances/me` handler behaviour identical to the current file — the only permitted change is the removal of any leave-type/policy construction, which is already absent.

The `IPolicyService` interface (including `listEffectivePolicies` and `getPolicyByLeaveTypeCode`) must remain unchanged and be the only policy surface balance depends on, matching `src/modules/policy/policy.service.interface.ts`.

integrationPoints.why: The single allowed policy-module surface through which balance obtains its policy collaborator, keeping the leave-type dependency hidden behind the policy module.
Must NOT be imported by the balance module; it remains reachable only through the policy module's factory.
